title: Right-unit component for the common-stage completed tensor lift
statement:
theorem completed_tensor_common_lift_constraints_right_unit
    (N : ∀ E, CompletedTensorFiniteModel l X R closed models E)
    (coherence : RingedDerivedTensorCoherence.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (ProEt.topology X) (ring l X R) closed models symmetry)
    (data : CompletedTensorCommonLiftTensorUnit l X R closed models symmetry) :
    ∀ A : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l (PadicAlgCl l) X,
      closed.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 _) data.unit.hom) ≫
          data.tensor.hom.app (A, pullbackTensorCommonUnit l (PadicAlgCl l) X) ≫
          (ordinary l X R).map (pullbackTensorCommonRightUnitor l (PadicAlgCl l) X A).hom =
        (closed.monoidal.rightUnitor ((ordinary l X R).obj A)).hom

proof.text: STATEMENT-DISPUTED: CompletedTensorCommonLiftTensorUnit records arbitrary tensor and unit isomorphisms. The new proved obstruction shows that the asserted universal right-unit law is incompatible with any nonidentity automorphism of the native tensor unit. N and coherence contain no equation mentioning data, so they do not supply the missing normalization. A proof of the original claim cannot proceed until the selected data and the parent constraints claims are repaired. The subsequent finite-model plan applies only to normalized comparison data.

Represent the selected constraint diagram at a finite coefficient field, apply the corresponding native coherence equation, and transport through common-stage comparison and independence under finite extension.
